Zone is a local-first shared scratchpad for macOS. Paste, drop, or type anything and it appears as a card on a board that your other Macs on the same network can see. No account and no server.

Requires macOS 26 or later. Download the disk image for your Mac (arm64 for Apple Silicon, x86_64 for Intel where provided), open it, and drag Zone into Applications.

This build is not notarized by Apple, so macOS will refuse to open it the first time. Try to open it once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click "Open Anyway".

To connect two Macs, open + on both, click Connect on one, and approve on the other when both show the same code.

This is an early version. It has automated tests but has had little testing between separate machines. There is no Windows or mobile app yet.
